The '''Outpost Overseer''' was an outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] located in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
